pal.meaning: deepest black: backdrop vignette, wells' inner dark
pal.evidence: i_tod_prompt_chassis icon well, row y150 x11..280 = #07060A (a250); i_tod_pm_row deepest bottom y186..191 = #040308; pip_off centre #0B0A11.

pal.meaning: row cards, buttons, small plates (gradient MID stop)
pal.evidence: i_tod_pm_btn fill median x300..800 y30..80 = #0F0E15 (column x500 runs #14131A at y10 to #0B0A11 at y88); prompt body #0D0C12; HUD tile #0E0E13; row card #0A090E.

pal.meaning: big panels' body
pal.evidence: i_tod_pm_panel_left row y600 x40..59 = #121119 (= docs/180 brief 'near-black blue panels #121119'); body median x600..900 y500..800 #14131B, lower #111018.

pal.meaning: header bands, column strips
pal.evidence: i_tod_pm_panel_left header band x1000..1300 y30..120 median #1C1B26; i_tod_prompt_chassis header band x330..880 y22..58 #1B1A25; sb column strip #201F2A.

pal.meaning: every hairline frame (the UNLIT tube)
pal.evidence: median of 11 measured 2-px hairlines: pm_row top y2 x600 #6B7589 / bottom y198 #60697C; pm_btn top y3 #666F82; panel_left inner frame x65..66 y600 #5D6577; prompt divider y227 #6E758D, outer y301 #78809A; h2_tile top #78809A; h2_round_badge outer #818AA6.

pal.meaning: top bevel / lit edge of steel, idle chevron, empty pip ring
pal.evidence: i_tod_pm_btn chevron x940..1010 brightest #8A93A8; i_tod_pm_pip_off ring row32 x50 #8A93A8 / x12 #818A9E; round badge window #8690AD.

pal.meaning: DEAD tube: locked / refused
pal.evidence: i_tod_prompt_chassis_locked: well frame x7..8 y150 #575F75 (normal #747C95), divider y227 #535A6E, outer #666E84 - a dimmed steel, no glow. Its red rule is the new dead_red role.

pal.meaning: FRAME LIGHT, READY / ACTIVE, the headline accent word, row icons
pal.evidence: i_tod_prompt_chassis header rule y67..71 x600 = #F2203A solid; UPGRADES face y255 #F11F39; SCOREBOARD word #FF203B; gauge you/down #F2203A; docs/180 brief '#F2203A (glow #FF3B52)'; Lua PM_RED 0.95,0.13,0.23. Rendered tube centre in the art: #FF5C76.

pal.meaning: FOCUS, rules, slashes, lit pips, icon wells, LOCKED IN
pal.evidence: red era lit every one of cyan's jobs RED: pm_btn_focus tube #FF5C76 + fill #22070E (TodPmButton focused glyph = PM_RED); rule after UPGRADES #FF5C76; tagline /// slashes red; pip_on body #DC233A halo #FF3B52; pm_row well x13..14 #F53C55 + wash #7B1625. NOT info text (-> infotext) and NOT a second lit colour on a red piece (-> steel_hi).

pal.meaning: secondary frames (content cards, ROUND box), hologram contour, circuits
pal.evidence: secondary frames were bright STEEL, no hue: pause ROUND box frame x789..790 y90 #8D99B3/#94A1BA, top y26 #9AA8C2; skull contour grey bone. Draw at glow <= 0.3. Dark twins -> dark_twin; idle bottom-edge runs -> idle_edge.

pal.meaning: RAMPAGE inner line only
pal.evidence: i_tod_h2_round_badge_rampage inner frame row y60 x17..18 #972030/#A82435, x96 y21..24 #9C2132..#9F1729 (a deep dim red inside the hot red outline). Fire / power-ups / reset-badge halo must NOT read this role.

pal.meaning: reset / warning badge only
pal.evidence: KEEP. i_tod_pm_reset_mark body row32 x20..44 = #FFB020 exactly, highlight #FFD572; Theme B class-card hazard stripes #CF8B23.

pal.meaning: POINTS only
pal.evidence: KEEP (gameplay colour, untouched by order). Red-era Z measured lemon #FFE935 (sb_points) / #FEEC36 (h2_points); do not change.

pal.meaning: secondary text (taglines, labels, flavour)
pal.evidence: i_tod_pm_panel_left tagline y135..160 #858EAB, subtitle #8189A6, STRONGER #8991AF, ROUND word #8189A5; legend SAME/MAP #828AA8; docs/180 'grey detail lines #7A829E'.

pal.meaning: primary text tint
pal.evidence: i_tod_pm_panel_left TOWER OF DOOM II face x700 y33..37 #EFF2F9..#F1F4FB (a cool white, not lavender); docs/180 'white names #EEF1F8'.

pal.meaning: info headings (UPGRADE CARDS, column titles)
pal.evidence: i_tod_pm_legend_box UPGRADE CARDS brightest x200..520 y40..90 #9DD0FF (brief #97C7F8); scoreboard column titles #52CBFF (brief #4FC3F7) = the deeper strip variant; effect-line Lua tint 0.50,0.78,0.96.

pal.meaning: the pad A button's identity colour
pal.evidence: KEEP (controller identity). The red-era pad art was a Map One leftover (cartoon), so there is no red-era value to restore.

pal.meaning: the dim run on an IDLE frame's bottom edge (button, icon button, tile)
pal.evidence: i_tod_pm_btn bottom edge y108..109 #86D3FB/#86D4FB with glow #4A90E7..#539BEB; i_tod_h2_tile y123..124 #86D4FC; docs/180 'faint blue light on the bottom edge'. Synthwave fallback = violet.

pal.meaning: dark-card twins (_violet row, pip, sb row)
pal.evidence: docs/180/181 'violet #B45CFF'; i_tod_pm_row_violet well line x13..14 #CB76F6, wash #5E3283; pip_on_violet body #A65CE5 halo #C886FF; Lua PM_VIOLET 0.71,0.36,1.00 never changed.

pal.meaning: the refused card's rule + broken edge
pal.evidence: i_tod_prompt_chassis_locked header rule y67..71 x600 #7A1422 (normal #F2203A); top edge y2 alternates #9C3144 dashes with steel #666E84 (a broken red light).

pal.meaning: optional faint outer sheen on steel lines
pal.evidence: outer pixel of every red-era steel frame: pm_row y0 #4A75AC a40, prompt x0 #5179AE a37, tile y0..2 #4C78B0 a7..19, panel top #446C9F a30 - 1 px, alpha 0.03..0.20.
